description.value:
Duration while the duel lasts

You are not in a hurry. They will be, eventually.

Each round after the first in which you have both attacked your marked target and been attacked by it, you gain a cumulative +1 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against it, to a maximum of +3. The bonus resets if a full round passes in which neither of you attacks the other, or if you mark a different creature.

cinderfall.incomplete: Cumulative +1 circumstance to damage against the mark per round both have attacked each other (after the first), capped at +3, resetting on a lull or a new mark. A dynamic, per-round "did both of us attack" counter has no rule-element analog anywhere in the engine, compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
